note: Startup CPU budget for the stdio MCP adapter bundle (lane 01M4VNTQFW, `pnpm mcp:startup:check`, docs/architecture/05-mcp.md §Cold-start bench). startupCpuMedianMs is the median, over 15 warm launches of packages/mcp/dist/index.js, of the adapter's own CPU time (user + system, Node bootstrap included) from process start to its tools/list reply. Seeded from the CI runner, not a laptop. Raising it requires replacing `justification`; the check refuses a raise that keeps origin/main's.

startupCpuMedianMs.justification: 2026-10-15 seed (230 ms, lane 01M4VNTQFW, PR #2621): CI's ubuntu-latest runner (4 CPU, AMD EPYC 9V45, node 22.23.3) measured a median of 203.3 ms over 15 warm launches (min 188.4, max 215.7; cold launch 240.8 ms, not counted). 230 is measured + ~13%, enough above the run-to-run spread not to flake and well under the 60 ms a local falsifier injected (median 243 -> 294 ms, caught). An Apple M3 laptop measures ~221 ms, so a laptop reading near the budget is not a CI red. Falsifier: two CI runs on an unchanged bundle whose medians differ by more than 20 ms -> the noise is too wide for this headroom; widen it or move to a fixed runner.
